beats.say: Two days ago, this city had one resident. Me. Today? {followers}.
And nearly every single one of you asked for a house. So I built them. All {houses} of them.
Kasparita commented first, so she gets house number one. Right by the sign.
Tamara wanted a neon pink house. It's very pink. You can probably see it from space.
Emilia asked for a car as a house. So now, she lives in a car. Great parking, though.
Christina asked for a mansion. Here's the mansion. Biggest house in town. For now.
We also got two Sophias. So, they're neighbours. That won't be confusing at all.
And Erinn just commented, Mee. Fair enough, Erinn. This one's yours.
Now, the vote. Stadium, {Stadium} percent. Hospital, {Hospital}. And the giant mall... {Giant mall} percent.
